name: Engel
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Engel in Grän – your gateway to the heart of Tirol!** Nestled in the breathtaking **Tiroler Alps**, just a stone’s throw from **Innsbruck**, **Engel in Grän** is a charming village where tradition meets adventure. Whether you’re seeking relaxation in our cozy guesthouses, thrilling hikes through the **Karwendel** or **Zillertal Alps**, or indulging in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine like crispy **Kaiserschmarrn** or savory **Käsespätzle**, every moment here feels like a fairy tale. **Discover the magic of winter:** ❄️ **Skiing & snowboarding** in nearby **Achensee** or **Seefeld** ❄️ **Cross-country trails** through snow-covered meadows ❄️ **Cozy mountain huts** with **Glühwein** and **Apfelstrudel** ❄️ **Sledding & ice skating** under the stars **Embrace the warmth of summer:** ☀️ **Hiking** to alpine lakes like **Achensee** or **Grünsee** ☀️ **Mountain biking** on scenic trails with panoramic views ☀️ **Farm visits** for fresh **Tiroler** dairy and **Obazda** ☀️ **Outdoor festivals** with live music and **Biergarten** vibes **Stay with us and experience authentic hospitality:** 🏡 **Family-run guesthouses** with wooden balconies and mountain views 🍽️ **Homestyle dining** featuring **Speckknödel**, **Leberkäse**, and **Dampfnudeln** 🚗 **Perfect location** for day trips to **Hallstatt**, **Swoveland**, or **Venice** **Engel in Grän – where every season tells a story!** --- **Visit our website** **Contact us** **info@engelingran.at** --- **

Your adventure starts here!

**
